t: The Bristan Blitz chrome-plated mono basin mixer tap offers a modern and functional solution for any bathroom installation. Constructed from durable brass, this deck mounted basin tap features a single lever for precise 1/4 turn control of water flow and temperature. Ideal for new builds or bathroom renovations, it includes a 5 Ltr/min flow regulator to help reduce water consumption without compromising performance. Supplied with flexible tap tails and a chrome-plated brass clicker waste, this Bristan basin mixer is suitable for all pressure systems, from 0.2 to 5 bar, ensuring reliable operation.
